public_payload_directory: public only; never include its parent or private_sources

arrays.compounds: One complete PubChem structure per id; retain stereo/form key
arrays.names: One computed English name per compound; no Korean claims
arrays.identifier_links: CID-to-complete-InChIKey identity only; no occurrence assertion
arrays.foods: Empty until food-field rights and context pass
arrays.relationships: Empty until food-occurrence rights and evidence pass

rules: Serve the manifest release as a snapshot; no mutable DB connection.
Display counts and zero food coverage truthfully.
Display PubChem attribution and source links; no agency endorsement.
Never map normalized names or first InChIKey blocks to exact identities.
Do not expose private bilingual names, aliases, candidates, paths, machine identities, or raw captured documents.
Unknown/rights-held data must remain unavailable, not synthetic sample rows.
